scope: Prospective factorial operator-learning follow-up after inspecting the single-step main study. Backbones and original 31-class numeric readouts are frozen. All four conditions share correct visible-state output distillation; only geometric edge correspondences vary. Words apply left-to-right to row vectors. ci (C then I) is the primary missing-answer test; ic (I then C) has the same LR-max answer as C and is secondary. Hidden-view operators are primary; output-view operators are diagnostic. No composite states enter fitting or validation. All48 operator fits finish before test features are extracted. Six fit repeats reuse three existing ordinary backbones; these are not six independent source trainings. Whole-epoch schedules preserve exact marginal exposure of every eligible state across conditions.
